monetary_flow_units: Actual-quarter billions of 2017-dollar PCE purchasing power
monetary_stock_units: Quarter-end billions of 2017-dollar PCE purchasing power; not annualized
wealth_rank: Bottom80/top20 by official DFA income percentile, not wealth percentile
BEA_vintage: Workbook published August26,2026; this release preserves the research vintage rather than using September revisions

quarterly_aggregation.unemployment: Three monthly seasonally adjusted rates, arithmetic mean; 2025Q4 uses only Nov/Dec because Oct was officially unavailable
quarterly_aggregation.SP500: Unadjusted monthly Close in third month of quarter, quarter-end price index, not total return

bls_unemployment_2026.json.used_months: 2026-01 through 2026-06; other reported months are not used
bls_unemployment_2026.json.vintage_status: Current public download; not the authors' original data vintage

sp500_yahoo_2026h1_monthly.json.vintage_status: Current public download; not the authors' original data vintage

limitations: Licensed Datastream input and original note454 vintage are unavailable; public Yahoo S&P 500 quarter-end price quotes are a documented adaptation.
Existing BEA workbooks were published August 26, 2026, and Z.1 archive released September 11, 2026; public DFA/BLS/market downloads use their current revisions.
DFA distributions are official quarterly estimates interpolated/extrapolated between SCF survey waves; income bins are not fixed cohorts.
BEA personal-sector consumption/income, household DFA wealth, and HH+NP loans have different source boundaries.

October2025 unemployment was not reported because of the lapse in appropriations;2025Q4 averages the two observed November/December rates. The raw missing value, monthly count and partial-quarter flag are retained; no interpolation.
The 2026 extension appends observed quarters to the existing revised public-data adaptation; it is not an original June2026-author forecast or exact historical-vintage replication.
2026Q1/Q2 unemployment each uses three actual monthly observations; the frozen October2025 gap and 2025Q4 two-month average remain unchanged.

bootstrap.status: Estimated joint two-stage parameter draws; conditional on observed predictor paths; both stages originally refitted

distribution_status: Derived factual macroeconomic inputs and model estimates; upstream provider/publisher originals are not redistributed; source rights remain with their holders
